title: Focus Management
summary: Focus marks the current keyboard point; it must stay visible, logically ordered and stable through dynamic changes.

MUST.text: Keep DOM order aligned with visual and task order; avoid positive tabindex.
Provide a visible focus indicator with at least 2 px outline (or equivalent) and ≥3:1 contrast.
Move focus deliberately after route changes, dialog open/close and dynamic validation, and restore it on close.

SHOULD.text: Preserve focus on the nearest meaningful element when content is removed or reordered.
Avoid focus jumps caused by layout shift or auto-scrolling.

AVOID.text: Do not remove outlines without a perceivable replacement.
Do not trap focus except inside an open modal, and always provide an escape.

DECIDE.decision: Move focus to main heading or landmark
Trap focus inside; restore trigger on close
Focus next sibling or stable container
Focus summary or first invalid field

EXAMPLE.good: "After deleting a row, focus moves to the next row action; after closing a dialog, focus returns to the trigger."
EXAMPLE.bad: "Focus stays on a removed element or jumps to the page top."

FAILURE_MODES: Invisible or obscured focus breaks keyboard navigation.
Focus not restored after modal close disorients users.
Layout shift can move focus off-screen or behind sticky headers.
